payload.entry: FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (completed before repair proposal): .1 #1, .2 #1, and .3 #1 all report the same strict docs-check failures. Corroborated the two in-repo anchor defects on existing bob-cli-kk (+1), and relayed the mounted validation.md -> bob-vim-yank-flash.md warning to its causal active epic bob-cli-kb (after reading kb and kb.1). Declined duplicate tasks. .2 #2 matches existing detached-grandchild pipe-drain flake bob-cli-kl; corroborated with +1, no duplicate. .2 #3 is distinct: created large flake task bob-cli-kp for highlights::diagrams::highlights_create_live_mermaid_pdf_is_highlights_safe, full-suite rendered 0/4 followed by isolated passes, with the BOB_DIR unused-vault diagnostic retained as a companion observation rather than an asserted root cause. Related closed bob-cli-9i is the different fixed pdftotext/raw-PDF fallback defect; did not reopen it. All evidence relays the identified phase notes; no fresh full-suite/docs reproduction claimed by this lander. Same-type/all-type searches, all 82 tasks created in the last week, and all 16 active epic scopes reviewed; only kb had a credible causal active-epic link. No child proposal remains untriaged. Current epic-owned creation and claim-guard gaps remain epic work in the repair tale, not separate tasks.

LANDING AUDIT / NOT READY: Reviewed epic scope and its one prior discovered-issue note, all three closed children and all eight child notes, approved child and parent plans, and relevant original research (resolved after audited research repo refresh). Read source and epic commits 3dce8a9e, 0d2f433d, aef23542. Verified structural owner/root catalog rows, shared region placement, additive list/check reporting, index+catalog sync consumption and stale-warning removal, standalone/nightly wiring, generated-section rejection/completion, shared creation transaction/rendering, command registration, and init claim preflight. The old no-op-sync note is addressed by plan_sync consuming catalog edits. Parent phase k3.6 DECISIONS are unchanged: mining/glossary work stays elsewhere and the rejected albums decision was not authored; no memory changes in these commits.

REMAINING EPIC WORK (source-confirmed, no runtime repro claimed): (1) create checks mixed-case destinations through a Markdown-only regular-file snapshot, so uppercase Base files and directory/symlink destination spellings escape refusal on case-sensitive filesystems; (2) catalog_read_dependencies omits negative claim evidence when an existing ordinary note becomes an album, plus non-host ancestry and nested identity inputs; verify_create ignores registry errors and host verification only checks edit presence, which does not prove a non-damaged current catalog; (3) records init treats partial discovery as no claimant and checks only TYPE, allowing config fallback for a folder-only album overlap. Existing concurrent-create test replans between commands, so it is not proof of same-plan race/rollback behavior. These bounded repairs and honest transactional regressions are in validated medium tale sase_plan_album_catalog_landing_repairs.md; no extra task beads for epic-caused defects.

INTEGRATION: fetched origin/master and fast-forwarded to ae6a28d0. Only non-epic commits after first epic commit are b8c71181 bank docs and ae6a28d0 bank import repairs. Reviewed overlapping docs and registry/restaurant path + directory guards; no conflicting album consumer found. Preserve all shared ReadDependencies variants, including directory_entries. No production code edits in this audit turn. No fresh just check or docs-check run; current Cargo target lacks debug/bob and installed bob lacks albums create, so neither is current verification evidence. Never ran check-full.

SYMBOLS/CLOSEOUT: epic-symbols k3.6.1 and k3.6 are both empty; no symvision recipe. Follow-up triage is fully recorded in the preceding note and must be included in the eventual close note.
